title: Launch Conductor — Lite checklist + weekly rollout notes (Jul 2026) [WIP]
summary: Compact release conductor checklist for mid-July feature drop; weekly rollout calendar, preflight, rollback matrix, and draft release notes. Intentionally lightweight to be used by small launches and night/weekend shifts.
content:
OVERVIEW

Purpose: this is a lightweight/portable launch conductor doc intended for small-to-medium releases where we want a clear single-page checklist + a 7-day rollout calendar and a customer-facing release notes draft. Use this for Hosted API and Dedicated control plane changes that do not touch private deployment on-prem packages.

Context & scope
- Release window: 2026-07-20 -> 2026-07-23 (primary cutover night: 2026-07-21 02:00 UTC)
- Affects: hosted API route resolver, autoscaler configuration, and a minor model-catalog metadata fix.
- Risk class: medium (config + routing) — not schema-changing, no DB migrations.
- Rollout style: staged ramp by region (us-west -> us-east -> eu-west) with a 30m hold per region.

WEEKLY ROLLOUT CALENDAR (high level)
- Mon 2026-07-19: Final preflight sign-off window, freeze docs, notify support and SE.
- Tue 2026-07-20: Dry-run in staging + smoke for internal teams (10:00 UTC). Canary helpers ready.
- Wed 2026-07-21 00:00 UTC: Preflight safety lane begins (monitoring checklists, throttles armed).
- Wed 2026-07-21 02:00 UTC: Cutover begins (us-west). 30m ramp, then hold/verify.
- Wed 2026-07-21 03:00–05:00 UTC: us-east ramp and verify.
- Wed 2026-07-21 06:00 UTC: eu-west ramp, full traffic check at +1h.
- Thu 2026-07-22: Follow-up telemetry digest and small hotfix window if needed.
- Fri 2026-07-23: Post-release retro + checklist closeout.

PRE-FLIGHT CHECKLIST (must be green before 02:00 UTC cutover)
- [ ] Owner assigned for cutover (primary: Liam Chen; backup: Nina Park) — owner confirmed.
- [ ] Release notes draft approved by PM (Priya) — pending small wording change on model compatibility.
- [ ] Jira blockers resolved (RINF-6721, RINF-6789) — blockers cleared by 2026-07-18.
- [ ] E2E smoke test suite pass in staging (merged branch + canary config) — run: staging-smoke-2026-07-20-10:12, 14/14 green.
- [ ] Load profile test at 2x baseline (batch kernel path exercised) — results attached in PR 4512.
- [ ] Canary config validated (health checks, timeouts, KV cache warm path) — config file: /repo/deploy/canary/2026-07-lite.json.
- [ ] Observability dashboards pinned (tokens per-token latency, error rate by route, autoscaler metrics) — dashboards: launch-lite-2026.
- [ ] Pager rotation & on-call notified (SRE, infra, serving-runtime lead) — pagers set.
- [ ] Customer comms ready (support playbook & canned replies) — support doc link in linked artifacts.
- [ ] Rollback procedures tested in staging (manual and automated rollback) — tests OK, duration ~4 min to revert routing.

DEPLOYMENT RUNBOOK (cutover window)
- T-60m: Final team sync on #release-day; confirm owners and backups, confirm access tokens.
- T-30m: Lock merges; post status to the channel: "Lock: success".
- T-15m: Snapshot current traffic routing config and autoscale state (save to S3).
- T-05m: Enable safety lane (throttle non-essential routes at 50%).
- T+0: Apply canary routing to us-west (target 5% traffic).
- T+10m: Increase to 25% if no errors; run quick smoke against canary endpoint.
- T+30m: If stable, promote to 100% for us-west; else, rollback to snapshot.
- Repeat for us-east and eu-west with the same cadence.

ROLLBACK MATRIX (quick reference)
- Symptom: 5xx error rate > 0.5% sustained for >10m in canary region -> Action: immediate rollback to snapshot routing, page SRE.
- Symptom: Median p50 latency spike > 2x baseline for >15m in promoted region -> Action: throttle traffic to 50% and promote fallback model; if persists, rollback.
- Symptom: Autoscaler flapping (scale up/down thrash) -> Action: disable autoscaler, fix config, rollback if necessary.
- Symptom: Customer-facing errors for top routes (>=3 customer reports in 30m) -> Action: emergency rollback, open incident bridge.

POST-RELEASE VERIFICATION (first 6 hours)
- Run smoke checklist: token create, small generation, chat flow with tool call, embedding sample. Expect green.
- Verify SLOs: p99 < 1.2s for text-gen default route; error rate < 0.2% global.
- Confirm KV cache hit-rate consistent with baseline (> 60% on long-running model sessions).
- Telemetry: check for anomalous spikes in cost-per-token.
- Confirm no increase in customer support volume (compare last 24h baseline).

COMMUNICATION PLAN
- T-24h: Notify GTM & SE (email + #release-day notice) with known changes and customer impact.
- T+1h and T+6h: Update status message in #release-day (automated via ops-bot).
- If rollback happens: post incident stub in #release-day and notify PM + support lead.

OBSERVABILITY & QUICK LINKS
- Dashboards: launch-lite-2026 (tokens-latency, route-errors, autoscale-activity)
- Tracing: trace sampling set to 10% for new paths during cutover.
- Canary logs: filtered tag = release:lite-2026; retention 7d.
- Incident bridge: +1-415-555-0182 (bridge code 8192) — test call pre-cutover.

KNOWN RISKS & MITIGATIONS
- Risk: routing config edge-case where older clients omit route-version header. Mitigation: compatibility fallback enabled; warn SE to monitor devices.
- Risk: small subset of model-variants may have KV cache regression — mitigation: keep older model-variant available and set routing policy to prefer fallback if latency>threshold.
- Risk: spike in autoscale cost during early ramp — mitigation: apply temporary burst cap.

RELEASE NOTES DRAFT (customer-facing — PM to finalize)
Title: July 2026: routing, autoscaler, and catalog fixes
Highlights:
- Improved routing fallback for older client headers to reduce 5xxs when model variants roll out.
- Autoscaler tuning to reduce spurious scale-ups during short-lived traffic bursts (expected to reduce cost by ~3% for P50 workloads).
- Minor catalog metadata fixes that improve model compatibility checks for dedicated deployments.

Details & impact:
- Hosted API: rolling rollout by region. No expected downtime; customers may see transient latency improvements.
- Dedicated: no changes to customer-managed clusters; catalog fixes apply to model onboarding checks only.

Known issues:
- We are tracking a small edge case where sessions > 2h may see slightly reduced cache hit rates until warm path is stable (workaround: reinitialize session to force cache refresh).

HOW TO ROLLBACK (for customers) — short note for SEs:
- If customers report regression post-22 July, escalate to release engineering with traces and request temporary routing pin to prior model-variant.

UNRESOLVED ITEMS / TODOS
- [ ] Final wording for "cost impact" section in release notes (PM: Priya).
- [ ] Confirm whether dedicated onboarding checks need opt-in (ENG: Diego).
- [ ] Validate that the trace sampling bump will not overload collector (SRE: Ellen).
- [ ] Add link to post-release telemetry digest blob to this doc (owner: Liam).

NOTES TO SELF / SHIFT HANDOFF TEMPLATE (to paste into #release-day)
- Cutover owner: Liam Chen (primary) — backup Nina Park.
- Key urls: staging-smoke run, PR 4512, dashboards (launch-lite-2026).
- If rollback: use saved snapshot id: snap-2026-07-21-01
- Post-mortem window: schedule 60m retro on Fri 2026-07-23 16:00 UTC.

ATTACHMENTS / ARTIFACTS TO ADD BEFORE CLOSEOUT
- Staging smoke run logs (staging-smoke-2026-07-20.log).
- Autoscaler test report (autoscale-2x-baseline-2026-07.pdf).
- Post-rollout telemetry digest (TBD link).

HISTORY / CHANGES IN THIS DOC
- 2026-07-08 Liam: created initial lite checklist and calendar.
- 2026-07-10 Nina: added rollback matrix and risk items.
- 2026-07-14 Priya: updated release notes draft and added tags.

END
